notes: The page begins with the continuing phrase kif-kif, and a closing parenthesis follows aplaties without an opening parenthesis earlier on this page. No matching opening delimiter is supplied. The final sentence continues to the last formula without a terminal full stop.

The original and each native-resolution half were inspected once, with all main baselines compared against C and H. Eleven local crops were created once from original-coordinate boxes and all eleven were visually inspected. Each was enlarged with LANCZOS to 2800 pixels wide, except the foliation at 2400, then autocontrasted and mildly sharpened. No rotation was applied.

The additional certainty-only normalisation-edge crop is crops/147_scan099_normalisation-edge.png, from original box [760, 890, 1693, 1090]; it was inspected for the clipped ending which the blind audit subsequently used to identify a substantive clipping correction.

The opening states that adding or removing branches aplaties does not change the connected components. It then refers to the relation between G and G-prime-subscript-zero and to morphismes de normalisation de m.graphes. These are the page’s assertions and written terminology, not independently established results here.

The following paragraph states composability of normalisation morphisms, preservation of strictness under composition, the category assertion, and the monomorphism assertion. It then compares strict sub-m.graphes with the set of parts of A(G), using the revised word antimorphe. No proof of any of those claims was attempted from this isolated continuation page.

The source’s singular/plural wording is retained exactly: Le composé de morphismes de \unsure{normalisat} strict est strict and morphismes de normalisation strict font une catégorie. H’s stricts forment has not replaced the visible strict font.

The detached dark period after définition is literal source punctuation at medium confidence. Both witnesses omit it, but its presence was confirmed independently by the main reader. The next baseline still begins des; no grammar repair is made.
The second normalisation touches the cropped right edge. The final reading retains only the visible normalisat prefix under a local doubt; the expected terminal ion is not supplied.

Quand is visibly retraced in place. No distinct old word, separate deletion, underline, or interlinear replacement can be isolated, so H’s extra deletion/addition structure is not introduced. The similarly retraced on after stricts remains ordinary live prose.

The three additions were checked independently for content and attachment: de norm. enters between morphismes and stricts, G enters after m.graphe before est, and anti replaces the cancelled short prefix before morphe. The long diagonal beside G is its attachment leader; the nearby prose est does not form a quotient or equivalence formula.

The old prefix iso stays doubtful under its strike. The live ordonné and morphe and the raised anti are clear. The author’s revision is reproduced as a cancelled tentative iso followed by inserted anti and live morphe, without expanding it to another technical term.

The final right parenthesis is visible at the edge and is restored against C. The compressed inner G/C remains unresolved. The other A(G) on the same baseline is clear; it is used for stroke comparison but does not force the terminal letter.
The lower-left 98 is pale foliation, not a dark authorial manuscript number. It is transcribed with margin and inventoried separately; ms_page is left empty. No date or other page number is visible.

The main reader reported independent inspection of the original and all eleven crops, agreeing with the resolved wording and insertion/deletion structure, the literal period, and the retained edge uncertainties. No OCR, external research, proof checking or TeX compilation was used.

Blind adjudication retains the abbreviation m.graphe(s), the literal singular strict before font and the live retraced Quand. It shortens the clipped second normalisation to the exposed normalisat prefix. At the final formula, the compressed inner G/C and a separate closing curve are visibly present and are not omitted.
